about: Durations of nested tuplets as exact rationals of a whole note (W), and each tuplet's members adding up to its nominal length (G01 §6.5, A3).
spec: G01 §6.5: a triplet eighth is 1/8 x 2/3 = 1/12; a 5:4 sixteenth 1/16 x 4/5 = 1/20; a 6:4 sixteenth 1/16 x 4/6 = 1/24; a 3:2 32nd inside 5:4 is 1/32 x 2/3 x 4/5 = 1/60.
